chunks: As for what Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allah narrated from al-Hasan ibn Musa al-Khashshab, from Ghiyath ibn Kallub, from Ishaq ibn ʿAmmar, from Abu ʿAbd Allah عليه السلام, from his father, that ʿAli عليه السلام used to say:

What has preceded of the takbirs of the funeral prayer is not made up. So the correct understanding of this narration is that it is not made up in the manner it would originally be begun, with separation between them by supplication; rather, it is only made up consecutively. This indicates that.

key_terms.تَكْبِيرِ الْجِنَازَةِ: the takbirs of the funeral prayer

ai.seo_question: How should missed takbirs in the funeral prayer be made up according to this narration?
ai.summary: This report addresses the ruling for one who misses some of the takbirs in the funeral prayer. It explains that the missed takbirs are not performed in their original spaced format with du'a between them, but are instead made up consecutively.
